name: A2A Broker Adapter
description: Config-only opt-in surface for standalone A2A broker routing.

baseUrl.label: Broker Base URL
baseUrl.help: Base URL for the standalone a2a-broker service.

edgeSecret.label: Edge Secret
edgeSecret.help: Optional x-a2a-edge-secret header value for protected broker routes.

requester.id.label: Requester ID
requester.id.help: Default x-a2a-requester-id header when OpenClaw calls the broker directly.

requester.kind.label: Requester Kind
requester.kind.help: Default x-a2a-requester-kind header when OpenClaw calls the broker directly.

requester.role.label: Requester Role
requester.role.help: Default x-a2a-requester-role header when OpenClaw calls the broker directly.

operatorEvents.enabled.label: Operator Event Bridge
operatorEvents.enabled.help: Opt-in SSE bridge for broker /a2a/operator/events, surfaced through a2a.monitor.status operatorEvents mode.

noDuplicateSend.enabled.label: No-Duplicate-Send Gate
noDuplicateSend.enabled.help: Hardened pre-send gate that blocks duplicate broker task creation when the same session+intent+message fingerprint is replayed. Defaults to enabled (fail-closed).

wakeOnTask.enabled.label: Wake on Task
wakeOnTask.enabled.help: Opt-in task wake bridge for accepted broker tasks.

operatorEvents.notification.enabled.label: Operator Notification Delivery
operatorEvents.notification.enabled.help: Explicit opt-in for legacy per-worker operator terminal notification delivery. Leave false for broker task-report based round summaries; stale targets are ignored while disabled.

operatorEvents.notification.channel.label: Operator Notification Channel
operatorEvents.notification.channel.help: Destination channel for operator terminal notifications, for example telegram.

operatorEvents.notification.to.label: Operator Notification Target
operatorEvents.notification.to.help: Destination target for operator terminal notifications, for example telegram:<operator-chat-id>.

operatorEvents.notification.accountId.label: Operator Notification Account ID
operatorEvents.notification.accountId.help: Optional channel account id when multiple channel accounts are configured.

operatorEvents.notification.threadId.label: Operator Notification Thread ID
operatorEvents.notification.threadId.help: Optional thread/topic id for notification delivery.

operatorEvents.terminalOutboxCursor.label: Terminal Outbox Cursor
operatorEvents.terminalOutboxCursor.help: Optional one-shot canary cursor for controlled Terminal Brief live proof.

operatorEvents.terminalOutboxAllowedIds.label: Terminal Outbox Allowed IDs
operatorEvents.terminalOutboxAllowedIds.help: Optional one-shot canary allowlist of terminal outbox event ids/prefixes.

operatorEvents.terminalOutboxReconcileUn.label: Terminal Outbox Startup Reconcile
operatorEvents.terminalOutboxReconcileUn.help: Optional canary switch; false skips startup unacked backlog reconciliation.

operatorEvents.localBrokerId.label: Local Broker ID
operatorEvents.localBrokerId.help: Stable broker id for this Gateway, used to decide whether parent-owned Terminal Brief rows are locally sendable or must be suppressed.

operatorEvents.notification.allowUnconfi.label: Allow unconfirmed provider send
operatorEvents.notification.allowUnconfi.help: Canary-only: send one provider message even when current-session-visible receipt capability is unavailable; never counts as Terminal ACK.

operatorEvents.crossBrokerTerminalRelay..label: Cross-broker Terminal Relay
operatorEvents.crossBrokerTerminalRelay..help: Relays fresh post-cursor terminal outbox projections with cross-broker handoff metadata to the configured origin broker.

operatorEvents.crossBrokerTerminalRelay..label: Origin Broker Base URL
operatorEvents.crossBrokerTerminalRelay..help: Origin broker URL that accepts bounded cross-broker terminal projections.

operatorEvents.crossBrokerTerminalRelay..label: Origin Broker Edge Secret
operatorEvents.crossBrokerTerminalRelay..help: Optional edge secret for the origin broker projection endpoint.

operatorEvents.crossBrokerTerminalRelay..label: Handoff Broker ID
operatorEvents.crossBrokerTerminalRelay..help: Stable id for this handoff broker included in terminal projections.

operatorEvents.crossBrokers.label: Cross-broker Projections
operatorEvents.crossBrokers.help: Bounded remote broker projections for Terminal Brief handoff monitoring; does not execute provider sends or Terminal ACKs.

enabled.label: No-Duplicate-Send Gate
enabled.help: Hardened gate: blocks duplicate broker task creation from replay-prone callsites. Defaults to enabled (fail-closed).
